pois.name: Castelo de São João de Arade
pois.wikipedia: pt:Castelo de São João do Arade
pois.intro: The Fort of São João do Arade, sometimes referred to as the Castle of Arade, is a medieval fortification situated in the civil parish of Ferragudo in the Portuguese Algarve municipality of Lagoa.

pois.name: Farol da Ponta do Altar
pois.intro: The Ponta do Altar Lighthouse is located in the Ferragudo parish of the Lagoa municipality in the Faro District of Portugal. The lighthouse, of unusual design, consists of a small square turret attached to a one-story caretaker's house.

pois.name: Algar Seco
pois.intro: Carvoeiro is a town and a former civil parish in the municipality of Lagoa, Algarve, Portugal. In 2013, the parish merged into the new civil parish Lagoa e Carvoeiro.

pois.name: Praia da Rocha
pois.intro: Praia da Rocha is a beach and built up area on the Atlantic Ocean in the southern section of the concelho of Portimão, Algarve, southern Portugal. On the eastern edge of the beach stands the Fort of Santa Catarina, a 17th century fortress built to defend the mouth of the Arade River, and now a popular tourist attraction accessible directly from the beach or the road above.

pois.name: Monumentos Megalíticos de Alcalar
pois.intro: The Megalithic Monuments of Alcalar are a group of burial tombs that comprise a Calcolithic necropolis, located in the civil parish of Mexilhoeira Grande, municipality of Portimão, Portugal.

pois.name: Estação Romana da Quinta da Abicada
pois.wikipedia: pt:Estação Romana da Quinta da Abicada
pois.intro: Abicada is the name of Roman ruins in Mexilhoeira Grande, to the north of the civil parish of Alvor, municipality of Portimão, in Algarve region, Portugal. In Roman times it was in the colony of Ipses, in the Roman province of Lusitania, which was authorized to mint currency, and where a woman named Pompeia Exoce looked after the burial of her grandson.

pois.name: Forte de Santa Catarina
pois.intro: The Fort of Santa Catarina is a medieval fort situated in the civil parish of Portimão, in the municipality of Portimão in Portuguese Algarve. The structure was considered one of the last Philippine military projects in the Algarve, erected to defend the peninsula from pirates and privateers, as well as military invasions.

pois.name: Castelo de Alvor
pois.intro: The Castle of Alvor is a medieval castle in the civil parish of Alvor, in the Portuguese district of Faro: considered to be a significant military monument associated with the nearby Castle of Silves.

pois.name: Torre da Lapa
pois.intro: A Torre da Lapa, igualmente conhecida como Torre da Marinha, é um monumento militar na freguesia de Ferragudo município de Lagoa, na região do Algarve, em Portugal. Foi classificado como Monumento de Interesse Público em 2020.

pois.name: Farol de Alfanzina
pois.intro: Le phare d'Alfanzina est un phare situé sur Ponta de Alfanzina dans la freguesia de Praia do Carvoeiro de la municipalité de Lagoa, dans le district de Faro. Il est géré par l'autorité maritime nationale du Portugal à Oeiras.

pois.name: Praia da Angrinha
pois.intro: Praia da Angrinha is situated along the wide estuary of the Arade River, south of Ferragudo, in Lagoa Municipality, Portugal. Map location: 37°07′12″N 8°31′20″W Protected by the large moles extending out towards the Portimão shore opposite, the beach is long and enclosed by heights in the land, now much eroded by the elements.

pois.name: Praia Grande (Ferragudo)
pois.intro: Praia Grande is a beach situated in the civil parish of Ferragudo, municipality of Lagoa, the Portuguese Algarve. One of many beaches to obtain the name Praia Grande, this coastal zone is located on the eastern back of Rio Arade estuary, south of the town of Ferragudo.

pois.name: Praia do Pintadinho
pois.intro: A Praia do Pintadinho é uma das mais conhecidas praias do município de Lagoa. Encontra-se na freguesia de Ferragudo, do lado direito da praia do Molhe.

pois.name: Praia do Molhe
pois.intro: A Praia do Molhe situa-se em Ferragudo, no município de Lagoa, no Algarve, Portugal. O seu nome é devido ao facto de possuir um dos molhes que demarca o fim do rio Arade e o início do Oceano Atlântico.

pois.name: Praia do Vau
pois.intro: A Praia do Vau é uma praia oceânica no município de Portimão, no Algarve, Portugal. Tem um areal ladeado por arribas suaves.

pois.name: Parque Municipal do Sítio das Fontes
pois.intro: The Parque Municipal das Fontes, or Fontes de Estômbar, is a park surrounding a major spring situated on the left bank of the estuary of the Arade River, north of the town of Estômbar, in Lagoa Municipality. The park, formally created in 1989, consists of about de 18 ha and is an important ecosystem site reserved for those interested in nature.

pois.name: Gruta de Ibne Ammar
pois.intro: La grotte d'Ibn Ammar est située dans la freguesia de Estômbar e Parchal, sur le territoire de la municipalité de Lagoa.
